filesystem.description: File operations — read, write, search, move files in allowed directories.

sqlite.description: Direct SQL access to JRVS memory database — query conversations, documents, chunks.

github.description: GitHub — search repos, read files, manage issues and PRs, view commits.

sequential-thinking.description: Structured step-by-step reasoning for complex multi-part problems.

brave-search.description: Web search via Brave. Set BRAVE_API_KEY in .env (https://brave.com/search/api/)

puppeteer.description: Browser automation — runs headless (no visible window). Screenshots, evaluate JS, fill forms.

slack.description: Slack — read channels, post messages, search workspace. See _setup_instructions.

memory.description: DISABLED: JRVS uses its built-in FAISS/Mem0 vector store. This would create a parallel shadow store invisible to RAG retrieval.

fetch.description: DISABLED: Package broken at time of testing. JRVS built-in /scrape and /search handle URL fetching.

puppeteer_old.description: MOVED TO ACTIVE — Chromium installed at /usr/bin/chromium-browser.

_comment: Paths support ~ (home dir) and $ENV_VARS — expanded at runtime by JRVS. BRAVE_API_KEY and GITHUB_TOKEN are read from .env.

filesystem.note: ~/Desktop added so JRVS can see your desktop files.

example_prompts: Search GitHub for Python FastAPI examples
List open issues on my JRVS repo
Show me the latest commits on Xthebuilder/JRVS-main
Think step by step about how to redesign my database schema
Use sequential thinking to plan a new feature

steps: 1. Add BRAVE_API_KEY=<your_key> to .env (same key you use with /search)
brave-search.note: The built-in /search command works independently of this MCP server.

steps: 1. https://api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From scratch
2. OAuth & Permissions → Bot Token Scopes: channels:history, channels:read, chat:write, reactions:read, users:read, groups:read
3. Install to Workspace → copy xoxb-... token
5. Paste both into the slack env fields above, restart JRVS

enable_steps: 2. Move puppeteer from _disabled_servers to mcpServers in this file
